title: fix(codex): coalesce thread/list refresh globally, not per session
context:
thread/list is a global RPC -- one reply carries every thread the
app-server knows -- but _codex_app_server_refresh_thread_status throttled
it per session id. /api/session-status is polled once per visible Codex
session, so N open sessions meant N identical thread/list requests every
couple of seconds against the single serialized app-server stdio channel.

The backlog starves everything sharing that channel: activity.log shows
thread/list replies landing 3-22s after their 3s timeout, plus PROBE
decision: Changed server.py, tests/test_codex_thread_list_coalescing.py: added _codex_app_server_thread_is_known, ThreadListCoalescingTests, setUpClass, setUp, _reply, test_many_sessions_share_one_thread_list_call, fake_request, test_concurrent_pollers_do_not_queue_duplicate_requests; new dep(s): importlib, threading, time, unittest; 1 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: importlib, threading, time, unittest.
